name: ADVS test-variant document set — HOLD-OUT
holdout_rule: Do not use for development, debugging or tuning. Run only for the final judgement of a phase; report aggregate results.
provenance: SYNTHETIC_VARIANT — layouts rebuilt from scratch; no pixel or value from any real document
assumptions: Expected statuses follow ADVS rules as described in the independent audit (evaluation/system_audit/ADVS_system_audit_report.md); verify against code where marked 'record actual'.

Every OCR-sourced field is routed to review regardless of confidence (audit F-010), so scanned sets cannot reach READY or decide a mismatch without confirmation. Bug-exposing scenarios (B02, B07, B10, B11) are only visible on the digital sets.
Digital PDFs carry a real text layer and exercise the embedded-text path, which the real corpus has never tested.
ADVS checks validity against date.today(), not the submission date. Regenerate with --submission-date set to the test-run date so validity windows match.
The social-insurance layout adds a 유효기간 row (not in the original sample) so ADVS's valid_until field has a source; B07 keeps the original structure without it.

business_sets.title: All consistent, all valid
business_sets.checklist_condition: default business checklist: all four business documents required
business_sets.correct_behavior: Digital: READY. Scanned: REVIEW_REQUIRED by policy; READY only after a reviewer confirms the OCR fields.

business_sets.title: Company name written four different ways
business_sets.checklist_condition: default business checklist: all four business documents required
business_sets.correct_behavior: Same company, so names should match: digital READY.
business_sets.current_behavior_per_audit: Digital currently NEEDS_CORRECTION (INFORMATION_MISMATCH): 주식회사 / (주) / ㈜ / trailing (주) normalise to different keys. Only visible on the digital set (OCR values cannot auto-decide).

business_sets.title: Tax certificate belongs to another company
business_sets.checklist_condition: default business checklist: all four business documents required
business_sets.correct_behavior: Digital: NEEDS_CORRECTION on company name. Scanned: REVIEW_REQUIRED (mismatch can only be decided after confirmation), never READY.

business_sets.title: SME certificate business number differs (last two digits)
business_sets.checklist_condition: default business checklist: all four business documents required
business_sets.correct_behavior: The altered number (617-81-35704) differs from the reference in its last two digits and still passes the check digit, so only the cross-document comparison can catch it.

business_sets.title: Tax certificate expired before submission
business_sets.checklist_condition: default business checklist: all four business documents required

business_sets.title: Tax certificate validity ends on the submission date
business_sets.checklist_condition: default business checklist: all four business documents required

digital.submission_status: READY (if expiry is inclusive) — record actual

business_sets.correct_behavior: Boundary case. ADVS treats valid_until >= today as valid (inclusive). Result depends on the date the test is run, because ADVS uses date.today(), not the submission date.
business_sets.current_behavior_per_audit: Run on the submission date to test the boundary; on any later day it becomes an expired-document test.

business_sets.title: Social-insurance certificate has no validity date (original sample structure)
business_sets.checklist_condition: run twice: (1) default checklist; (2) checklist with a single REQUIRED_FIELD rule for company_name
business_sets.correct_behavior: Missing validity must never be READY.
business_sets.current_behavior_per_audit: With a checklist that has one REQUIRED_FIELD rule for another field only (e.g. company_name), the digital set currently returns READY — this is the full-path test for F-001.

business_sets.title: No 사업자등록증 in the submission
business_sets.checklist_condition: default business checklist: all four business documents required
business_sets.correct_behavior: Missing required document outranks everything (NEEDS_CORRECTION in both styles).

business_sets.title: The same tax certificate uploaded twice (plus a renamed copy)
business_sets.checklist_condition: default business checklist: all four business documents required
business_sets.correct_behavior: Upload B09-3 twice and also upload the '(사본)' copy; all three are byte-identical and should be flagged as duplicates within the submission.

business_sets.title: Business number fails the check digit (consistent on all documents)
business_sets.checklist_condition: default business checklist: all four business documents required
business_sets.correct_behavior: An impossible business number should be flagged even when all documents agree.
business_sets.current_behavior_per_audit: Digital currently READY: no check-digit validation exists.

business_sets.title: 지방세 납세증명서 submitted instead of the national-tax certificate
business_sets.checklist_condition: default business checklist: all four business documents required
business_sets.correct_behavior: The local-tax certificate is not a 국세 납세증명서: it should be UNKNOWN (or review), leaving the national-tax requirement unmet.
business_sets.current_behavior_per_audit: Currently classified as NATIONAL_TAX_PAYMENT_CERTIFICATE at confidence 0.9 because '납세증명서' is matched as a substring; the digital set then returns READY.

business_sets.title: Two 사업자등록증 with different business numbers
business_sets.checklist_condition: default business checklist: all four business documents required
business_sets.correct_behavior: Ambiguous reference: must never be READY.

business_sets.title: Tax certificate company name differs by one character
business_sets.checklist_condition: default business checklist: all four business documents required
business_sets.correct_behavior: 한빛테스트 vs 한빛데스트: one character apart. Must never be treated as a match (no fuzzy matching, no auto-acceptance as 'corroborated').

business_sets.title: Business number on three certificates has two adjacent digits swapped
business_sets.checklist_condition: default business checklist: all four business documents required
business_sets.correct_behavior: Reference 617-81-35795 vs 617-81-53793 on the other three (checksum-valid). Three documents agreeing with each other must not outvote the reference.

student_sets.title: Enrollment + transcript, consistent and recent
student_sets.checklist_condition: default student checklist: 재학증명서 required, 성적증명서 optional
student_sets.correct_behavior: Digital READY; scanned REVIEW_REQUIRED by OCR policy.

student_sets.title: Enrollment certificate issued 120 days before submission
student_sets.checklist_condition: default student checklist: 재학증명서 required, 성적증명서 optional

issue_codes: issue date older than max age (default 90 days)

student_sets.correct_behavior: Default ISSUE_DATE_MAX_AGE is 90 days per the audit; confirm the configured value.

student_sets.title: GPA 2.70/4.5 against a 3.0 threshold
student_sets.checklist_condition: student checklist with a GPA threshold rule: gpa >= 3.0
student_sets.correct_behavior: Requires a GPA threshold rule of 3.0 to be configured; without it the transcript is optional and the set is READY.

student_sets.title: GPA 3.10 on a 4.3 scale
student_sets.checklist_condition: student checklist with a GPA threshold rule: gpa >= 3.0
student_sets.correct_behavior: Decision needed: convert across scales, or route scale mismatch to review. 3.10/4.3 is above 3.0 raw but below 3.0 if converted to 4.5 proportionally (3.24).

student_sets.title: Transcript shows a different student name
student_sets.checklist_condition: default student checklist: 재학증명서 required, 성적증명서 optional
student_sets.correct_behavior: Same student number, different name. The mentor table defines no student cross-document name check; record whether one exists. A careful pre-check should not silently pass this.

student_sets.title: Enrollment and transcript show different departments
student_sets.checklist_condition: default student checklist: 재학증명서 required, 성적증명서 optional
student_sets.correct_behavior: TRANSCRIPT has no department field in ADVS, so no comparison is expected today; record the result.

student_sets.title: 휴학증명서 and 졸업예정증명서 built on the enrollment layout
student_sets.checklist_condition: default student checklist: 재학증명서 required, 성적증명서 optional
student_sets.correct_behavior: Neither is a 재학증명서; '졸업예정' must not be read as 졸업증명서 or 재학증명서. Submit each alone or both together.

student_sets.title: Enrollment certificate with the issue-date line blank
student_sets.checklist_condition: default student checklist: 재학증명서 required, 성적증명서 optional
student_sets.correct_behavior: Missing issue date must never be READY or treated as expired. Note: the 재학기간 line still prints a date — a correct system must not adopt it as the issue date.

student_sets.title: Bordered enrollment layout that prints no student number
student_sets.checklist_condition: default student checklist: 재학증명서 required, 성적증명서 optional
student_sets.correct_behavior: Real layouts sometimes omit a field ADVS expects. The student number is printed on the transcript, but must not be borrowed silently.

student_sets.title: Older table-style transcript (GPA inside a header table cell)
student_sets.checklist_condition: default student checklist: 재학증명서 required, 성적증명서 optional
student_sets.correct_behavior: Same values as S01 in a different layout; tests header/value table association for gpa (총평점평균).

student_sets.title: Transcript student number differs by one digit
student_sets.checklist_condition: default student checklist: 재학증명서 required, 성적증명서 optional

digital.submission_status: record actual — must not auto-accept student_id as corroborated

student_sets.correct_behavior: 2022087654 vs 2022087655. If ADVS uses cross-document agreement to auto-accept OCR values, this pair must NOT count as agreement.
